entries.summary: Unreliable tool/function calling — broken or ignored tool schemas are a recurring report across runtimes. This is not an agent model.

mitigations.note: Community-fixed chat templates (unsloth's GGUFs) improve it somewhat.
For agents, use base Qwen3-8B and keep this one for pure reasoning.

citations.title: vLLM issue: R1-0528 distill function calling

entries.summary: Very long, redundant chains of thought — it can spend thousands of tokens re-deriving a simple answer, which is slow and floods small context windows.

mitigations.note: temp 0.6 per the card; cap max output tokens; save it for problems that deserve the thinking.
